column4: Pixel-art game HUD sprite in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage, Blood): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, strong simple shading, slightly worn and grimy, human and imperfect, not clean modern pixel art. A single object seen exactly straight from the front, filling most of the canvas: a 1990s black plastic alphanumeric belt pager like a Motorola Advisor, wider than tall, with one large rectangular blank grey-green LCD window across its upper two thirds (completely empty, no text, no numbers, no icons), a thin dull chrome bezel round the LCD, a small dark red LED at the top right corner, three small grey rubber buttons in a row under the LCD, scuffs, scratches and dust on the plastic. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no shadow, no text, no logo, no border, no watermark.

Pixel-art game icon sheet in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage, Blood): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, strong simple shading, slightly worn and grimy, human and imperfect, not clean modern pixel art. Five separate small objects in one row, evenly spaced with wide gaps, each seen from slightly above, all the same size: 1) a neatly made-up camp bed seen from above: a folded grey wool army blanket with a plain white pillow on it, 2) a dull chrome shower head on a short bent pipe, 3) a dented white enamel slop bucket with a wire handle, 4) a rolled bundle of wet stained striped bedding, 5) a thick hand-painted green tick mark. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around and between them, no shadow, no text, no labels, no numbers, no border, no watermark.
